job.name: 08-v1
job.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, precise animation pose edit. FIRST IMAGE is existing character view/painting and pose starting point. SECOND is confirmed NORTH idle identity. THIRD is approved hand-painted chibi style only; no UI. ONE native-HD square RGBA frame, true transparent background, not a sheet. Strict BACK view running NORTH/AWAY FROM VIEWER, no face. Exact girl: brown-black long hair/high bun, red-star gold crown and tassels, black-red-ivory ornate star robe, waist chains, black/gold boots. RIGHT hand (SCREEN RIGHT in back view) grips round star-disk LOWER HANDLE. LEFT hand (SCREEN LEFT) holds exactly THREE black/gold star cards. Exactly two connected arms/hands and legs. Same original scale/fixed camera: bun top about5%, pelvis about74%, virtual floor94%, body centered x50%; small running bob, no frame-filling resize. Narrow sagittal running corridor: knees/toes straight AWAY along N, no lateral splay. Correct BACK boots: heels/rear shafts face viewer; no front-vamp star or broad toe cap facing viewer. Small gold cuff/heel ornaments may show. Trailing lifted boot may show sole as knee folds. No ground, shadow, particles, text, effects, extra props. Same polished crisp brushwork. Relaxed medium jog, low bounce/short flight, NOT marching, high knees or big jump. Shoulder/elbow counter-swing with props retained, NOT motionless display pose.
N08 VERY LATE FLIGHT, immediately before RIGHT foot landing. RIGHT leg screen-right reaches forward/away and down, ankle dorsiflexes slightly, BACK OF HEEL faces viewer, lowest heel almost reaches same floor as original N09 contact. LEFT leg trails bent toward viewer with sole visible, higher. Lower right foot a small step relative to FIRST image without moving entire character. Keep arms at opposite extremes (cards left high, disk right low) with natural bent elbows. Distinct pose from N07 and N09, not a copy; no ground shadow.
